displayResolver.note: An explicit display (the flag) wins. showThinkingSummaries is read only for an interactive session; a non-interactive session (EYAS's SDK queries, stream-json output) gets no display unless the flag is given, and a text/json one gets 'omitted'. So the flag is the only way EYAS can ask this runtime for summarized thinking.
